asker_query: Doctor, I have lung cancer, on osimertinib, last scan was good, stable. I have a small occasional cough — nothing major. What can I do for that? What symptoms should I watch out for and report? Any general advice for my health?
answer:
For your stable stage IV NSCLC with occasional cough, prioritize non-drug strategies: postural drainage, steam inhalation, and effective coughing techniques (avoid lying flat). Correctable causes (infection, pleural effusion) should be ruled out. Pharmacologically, consider bronchodilators or antitussives if needed (e.g., hyoscine for secretions).
